scores.visual_critic_note: Clean UI chrome with readable controls and decent button hierarchy, but the edge bundles collapse into an unreadable tangle at the center and the bottom nodes are cropped, undermining the core data encoding.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: No quantitative axes to truncate; scaleSqrt is correctly used for force-layout node sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent, and key functions are present, but radial/tree nodes use a hardcoded radius (5.2px) rather than a data-driven scale, and this is synthetic data throughout.
scores.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires unthrottled redrawLinks() on every input event with a broken '.transitioning' guard (class is never set), layout switches never call .interrupt() before creating new transitions, and click/hover handlers have no touch-event filtering leaving mobile open to ghost double-triggers.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The Circle Pack default view is overwhelmed by a dense spaghetti tangle of bundled edges converging at center — no individual connection is traceable — and the 8-layout + multi-slider control surface adds cognitive overhead before the viewer has parsed the chart.
